## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tried in demo mode (`npm run dev`), or against a real operator (say which)
- [ ] Screenshots for visible changes, in light and dark themes

## Security and data

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] New inputs are validated and size-limited; new endpoints check fleet membership
- [ ] Schema changes come with a migration and keep row level security on

Security issues: please report them privately as described in SECURITY.md, not in a pull request.
